data.other_hard: Exchange must be a pair of students under a cooperation agreement between a Korean and a European institution; minimum transfer of 10 credits or 20 ECTS per semester (language and sports courses not counted); exchange duration 120 to 180 days; Korean student must stay in Korea and European student must stay in Europe during the application period (leave of absence allowed); student status must be maintained until the exchange; applicants must not have already started the exchange; applications must be filed by the institution's international relations office
data.evidence_sentence: Undergraduate(bachelor) and Graduate(master) students who are currently enrolled in institutions in Korea or one of the 30 ASEM Europeans countries.
data.notes: Page describes the whole DUO-Korea programme rather than one individual award and covers both Korean and European students. The application deadline is not stated; the page refers to the 2026 spring term and a June 2026 decision, so the text is outdated relative to 2026-11-21. GPA and recommendation of institutions are considered in selection but no minimum is stated; new exchange projects not selected before DUO-Korea 2025 get priority (preference, not requirement). Fellowship amount and field of study are not stated.
